noodles/03bfd78:
The crackle one roll into a jam was the audio render thread missing its
2.67 ms quanta. Nothing had measured that thread: npm run probe:render
now traces its callbacks on seeded songs. On a desktop core the cold
open cost 278 ms/s and four rolls 254/253/376/381, climbing per roll,
with p99 quanta at 1.2-1.8 ms; a phone's audio core is 3-4x slower.

Almost none of it was the sound. Tone.Synth voices carry four
never-stopping ConstantSourceNodes, so an idle pooled voice rendered
like a sounding one (3.2 vs 3.5 ms/s; native 0.6 sounding, 0 idle);
Tone.Filter drives its biquad through connected Signals, forcing
per-sample coefficient math on every filter in the graph (3.5x a
native biquad); Tone.Phaser alone cost 51 ms/s.

The graph is native nodes now, Tone keeps the clock: per-note
oscillator+envelope voices writing Tone.Envelope's exact automation
(no pools, no GC switch-off, no trims), Tone.BiquadFilter everywhere,
chorus/phaser/tremolo/auto-filter/echo/drive rebuilt with Tone's
parameter math, slow LFO sweeps at k-rate, the synth kit out of the
graph under the sample bank. Sound-neutral: single notes null against
Tone to -105..-130 dB, calibrate within 0.1 dB on every row, audit
identical. Two fixes ride along: Tone's pooled voices opened every note
on the previous pitch for up to 128 samples, and stop let lookahead
notes start and chopped them.

Same songs after: cold 76-87 ms/s, rolls 70-106, p99 quantum
0.39-0.50 ms, no growth across rolls; main thread while playing
25/18/11% -> 14/10/9% busy at 4x throttle.

Smoke trades the pool-trim pins for the stronger invariants (under the
caps while playing, zero voices once a stop rings out) and stops
flaking on the vamp's four-scene arc; probe:pool is retired.

bits/038e568:
BITS is a video instrument: footage plays and finger gestures perform
the edit into an append-only recipe. This first slice is the ground
that thesis stands on: clips import into OPFS, Mediabunny probes and
decodes them through WebCodecs, and a pooled CanvasSink drives play
and scrub in a React shell.

The recipe module fixes the project format at version 0 with raw and
quantized timestamps stored side by side, so quantize stays a view
decision. The service worker precaches the shell from a build-emitted
manifest and accepts Android share-target POSTs into an OPFS inbox.
Base path is /bits/ for GitHub Pages under ampactor.dev.

Verified with vitest (6 tests), eslint, tsc, and a headless Chrome
probe of the built bundle.
